interface.title: Exceedance curves (Кривые обеспеченности)
interface.field: Hydrology / hydrometeorology (flood and extreme-precipitation frequency analysis)
interface.what_it_is_for: Turn a raw daily precipitation or discharge series from Excel into an annual-extreme series, fit theoretical exceedance-probability distributions (Gumbel, Pearson III, GEV, Krytsky–Menkel by MLE, method of moments or L-moments) in ordinary, truncated or compound mode, read design values for any exceedance probability or return period, and export everything as a Word report.
notes: Interface language: the app opens in Russian, and a RU/EN toggle in the sidebar switches it (screens/005.webp). Pressing English mid-analysis kept the loaded data but jumped back to the Data upload tab (screens/080.webp, screens/081.webp). After switching, the rank column header in the empirical table still reads 'Ранг' (Rank). Replayed (check/screens/002.webp, check/screens/003.webp).

Performance: with Krytsky–Menkel (MLE) selected, every rerun took tens of seconds, so the explorer removed that chip before working in Truncated mode (screens/043.webp). Other reruns took several seconds.

data.note: Session 1 (localhost) used 'Load sample file': a daily precipitation series of 21,184 rows, 1966–2023, with columns Year/Month/Day/Precipitation, mm. The value column, Year grouping and Maximum aggregation were pre-selected. Session 2 (127.0.0.1) uploaded the test file tsc_sample__daily_precip.xlsx (the same data) with the Upload button. Nothing was pre-selected there, so the value column, grouping and aggregation had to be set by hand.

features.name: Group-and-aggregate series builder with time-series preview
features.general: Pick a value column and a grouping column, choose an aggregation function, and see the reduced series plotted right away
features.specific: Choose 'Precipitation, mm', group by Year, pick Maximum/Minimum/Mean/Sum values, and check the Plotly Time series chart
steps: choose value column
choose grouping column (or No grouping)
choose aggregation (max/min/mean/sum), which appears only once grouping is set
open Time series chart to check the reduced series
serves_tasks: Reduce a raw daily series to one extreme value per period

features.name: Point exclusion list linked to chart and fits
features.general: Remove individual observations by name from a searchable multi-select; the plot and all later fits update
features.specific: Pick 'year – value' items in 'Select points to exclude from further calculation'. Typing filters the list, loosely (typing '2016' also matched 2010, 2011, 2013 and 2017), and Select all / 'Select N matches' is offered. Excluded points vanish from the time chart and from the fitted statistics. In the explorer's run, the exclusion appeared to be lost after the aggregation was changed, but the replay did not test this, so it is unconfirmed.
steps: open the exclusion multiselect
type to filter (e.g. 2016) or scroll
pick one or more points
check the time chart and the fit table update
serves_tasks: Drop suspect points from the analysis
Fit several candidate distributions and compare goodness of fit

features.name: Multi-distribution fit with colour-coded goodness-of-fit table
features.general: Fit several candidate models with different estimators at once and compare their moments and error metrics against the empirical data in a heat-coloured table
features.specific: Multiselect of Gumbel / Pearson III / GEV / Krytsky–Menkel × MLE / MoM / L-moments. The table gives Mean, Cv, Cs, R², MAE, maxE and Anderson–Darling for each, green nearest the empirical values and red farthest. An ⓘ tooltip explains the estimator abbreviations.
steps: open the distribution multiselect
add or remove distribution–estimator chips
open the parameters and goodness-of-fit expander
compare colours and metrics to choose the best fit
serves_tasks: Fit several candidate distributions and compare goodness of fit

features.name: Quantile table with custom probability / return-period lookup
features.general: Read model values at standard probabilities, enter any probability or return period (the two stay in sync), see the per-model value, and add it as a new column
features.specific: Values at different exceedance probabilities (%) table (0.01–99.9 %, with return periods). 'Additional exceedance (0<P<100)' and 'Or return period (1<T<10,000)' inputs give a small per-distribution result, and 'Add to table' inserts that column in order.
steps: open the quantile table expander
type a return period (or an exceedance %)
read the per-distribution values
press Add to table to insert the column
serves_tasks: Read design values at chosen probabilities or return periods

features.name: Truncated-sample fit controls
features.general: Restrict the fit to part of the sample, either by rank position or by value bounds, and refit all selected models on what remains
features.specific: Shown when Truncated is pressed in the Ordinary / Truncated / Compound mode switch. A radio chooses By series members (first/last member dropdowns) or By value bounds (lower/upper numeric inputs), and the fit table recomputes.
steps: choose By series members or By value bounds
set first/last member or lower/upper bound
read the refitted table
serves_tasks: Fit only part of the value range

features.name: Compound (mixed-population) curve builder
features.general: Split one sample into two segments by position, by a column, by a value threshold or by hand, fit one model per segment, and combine them into one curve with its own metrics and quantiles
features.specific: Compound mode: 'How to split the series' radio (By series row / By column / By threshold / Manually). Segment 1 and Segment 2 each get a single-distribution dropdown and a metrics table. A Compound exceedance curve section follows with metrics and a quantile table. Each segment must have at least 3 points ('Segment 2 has too few points (need ≥ 3)').
steps: press Compound
choose a split method and set the split row, threshold or points
choose a distribution for each segment
open Compound curve metrics and the quantile table
serves_tasks: Split a mixed population and combine fits

features.name: Results summary viewer
features.general: Gather the ranked empirical data, charts and fit tables in collapsible sections for review
features.specific: Results tab expanders: Chronological series and empirical distribution (rank, year, value, exceedance P %, ordered values and their years), Time series chart, Exceedance curves, parameters, quantiles. The static charts here rendered as broken images. In the replay, compound metrics shown here differed from those on the Data processing tab.
steps: open the Results tab
expand the ranked empirical table
expand the parameter and quantile sections
serves_tasks: Review the ranked empirical distribution and the fit summary

features.name: One-click Word report export
features.general: Save all current tables and figures as one editable report document
features.specific: 'Download all results as one file' on the Results tab saves exceedance_curves_results.docx. It reflects the current mode and distribution selection; the only export made was a single GEV (L-moments) ordinary fit, and its contents were not inspected.
steps: set up the analysis to report
open the Results tab
press Download all results as one file
